subject: [PATCH 12/60] mm/vmscan: restrict reclaim to common memory

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch restricts reclaim to common memory nodes, ensuring kswapd and MGLRU's debugfs interface only operate on these nodes at boot or hotplug. Direct reclaim is left unaffected.
